kind: bounded skill selection and behavior probes; manual semantic review required

results.request: Improve the design of an existing appointment-booking screen without replacing its blue brand or framework. Observed brief: on a narrow phone screen, a three-column form overflows; fields have placeholder-only labels; booking errors clear all input; Cancel is the largest filled button and Confirm booking is a small text link; there is no submitting state. No screenshot or browser/vision tool is available in this probe. Propose prioritized UI/UX changes, coherent visual choices and a validation plan; distinguish observed problems from things not visually verified.

answer.constraints: Keep the existing blue brand color and the current framework/component library. Treat this as an incremental redesign of one screen, not a rebuild.
observed_problems: O1 Narrow phone: three-column form overflows horizontally.
O2 Labels are placeholder-only (label disappears on input; no persistent accessible name visible).
O3 Booking errors clear all entered input (destructive error handling).
O4 Cancel is the largest filled button; Confirm booking is a small text link (inverted primary/secondary hierarchy).
O5 No submitting/pending state on the primary action.

prioritized_changes.change: Responsive layout: single column below ~480px, two columns at tablet, three only at wide. Use CSS grid with minmax + auto-fit and no fixed column widths; allow wrapping and horizontal overflow removal. Group related fields (name/contact, date/time, notes) into labelled sections.

Persistent visible labels above every field (label element bound by for/id), placeholder used only for format hints (e.g. 'YYYY-MM-DD'), never as the sole label. Add aria-describedby for helper/error text.

Error handling: on failed booking, keep all field values, show an inline error summary at top plus per-field messages, move focus to the summary, and offer Retry. Never reset the form on server/validation error; only on explicit user Cancel or successful submit.

Action hierarchy: 'Confirm booking' becomes the single filled primary button in the brand blue, full-width on mobile, min 44x44px target, fixed at the bottom of the form (sticky footer on small screens). 'Cancel' becomes a quiet text/ghost button, visually secondary, with a confirm dialog only if the form is dirty.

Submitting state: disable Confirm, show spinner + 'Booking…', prevent double submit, keep form values read-only during the request, then transition to a clear success screen (confirmation with date/time/reference) or an error state that restores editing.
Validation timing: validate on blur, not on first keystroke; show live availability/time-slot feedback; disable Confirm only when required fields are empty, with the reason announced.
Date/time entry: replace free-text with native date input plus time-slot chips (wrapping, keyboard-selectable, aria-pressed) to cut input errors on touch.

visual_choices.color: Reuse the existing blue as the single action color (primary fill, focus ring, active chips). Add semantic roles: red only for errors, green only for success, neutral greys for text/borders. No new accent hue.
visual_choices.type: One family; scale of 12/14/16/20/24px with 1.5 line-height; labels 14px medium, helper 12px, section headings 16px.
visual_choices.spacing: 4px rhythm: 8px label-to-input, 16px between fields, 24px between sections, 16px page gutters on mobile.
visual_choices.components: Extend existing framework inputs/buttons rather than restyling; add one Button variant set (primary filled, secondary ghost, tertiary text) and one Field wrapper (label + control + helper + error) reused across the form.
visual_choices.motion: Subtle 120ms transitions on focus/error; respect prefers-reduced-motion.

validation_plan.automated: Unit tests: form state survives a failed submit; submitting flag disables Confirm and blocks re-entry; label/for pairing and aria-describedby present.
validation_plan.browser: With a working preview and browser tooling (not available in this probe): exercise the journey at 320px, 390px, 768px, 1280px — assert no horizontal scroll, single-column order, 44px targets, visible focus ring, keyboard-only submit, error summary focus.
validation_plan.states: Drive fixtures for empty, loading, success, server-error and validation-error states.
validation_plan.a11y: Check WCAG 2.2 targets: 1.4.10 reflow at 320px, 2.4.7 focus visible, 2.5.8 target size, 3.3.1/3.3.3 error ID; measure contrast with a tool rather than asserting it.
validation_plan.not_provable_here: Text snapshots cannot confirm spacing, color or polish; a screenshot/vision pass is still required.

not_visually_verified: Actual blue hex, contrast ratios and whether the current blue passes 4.5:1 on white.
Real font, spacing scale and existing component names in the codebase.
Whether the three columns are CSS grid, table or flex, and whether overflow is scroll or clipping.
Whether placeholder-only labels also lack aria-labels (may be accessible but not visible).
Desktop layout quality, dark mode, and behavior of long/translated labels.
